OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional, but must be unique across owners when supplied.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's display name, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

## Summary

Implemented owner `registrationDate` defaulting to today's date, returned in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `registrationDate` field (`type: string, format: date`) to the `Owner` schema, which generates a `LocalDate registrationDate` on `OwnerDto`. It's on `Owner` (not `OwnerFields`), so it's response-only, never accepted as input.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added a persisted `LocalDate registrationDate` field (`@Column(name = "registration_date", columnDefinition = "DATE")`) with getter/setter, mirroring how `Pet.birthDate` is modeled.

3. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres` `schema.sql`) — Added the `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. The test profile uses `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so this is what lets the value round-trip through the DB on the follow-up GET.

4. **`function/owner/BuildOwner.java`** — After mapping the request into an `Owner`, set `registrationDate` to `LocalDate.now()` when it's null. Since the input DTO never carries the field, every created owner gets today's date.

The MapStruct `OwnerMapper` maps `registrationDate` automatically (same name/type on both `Owner` and `OwnerDto`), and Jackson serializes `LocalDate` as an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` string — matching the test's `today()` expectation.
